name: Submagic
tagline: Adds animated captions, b-roll and smart edits to short-form videos automatically.
about: Submagic is an editor for short-form video. It transcribes your clip, adds styled captions and b-roll, and can cut long videos into short ones.
pros: Adds b-roll, zooms and sound effects for you.
Cuts long videos into short clips.
cons: Plans cap the number of videos per month.
